journey.name: lnurl-auth action wording
journey.description: Verifies that the LNURL-auth sheet words its title, prompt and confirm button by the LUD-04 `action` of the request instead of always asking to log in. Preconditions: an onboarded wallet on Home. The links point at a dummy domain (site.example) and are only decoded, never confirmed: each step cancels the sheet.

actions.action: Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:LNURL1DP68GURN8GHJ7UMFW3JJUETCV9KHQMR99ASH2ARG8A6XZEEAD3HKW6TWYE4NZ0T9XFSKVD3JX56XZWRYVC6RXVEJXC6XVCFJXDNRVDM9VGURZWPCXCEN2EP3X43K2WPCXDJNSENRXQERQWFC89JR2E3CXFSK2DNXXYCK2FNPVD6XJMMW84KX7EMFDCUQ7SUT" to.bitkit.dev` (action=login)
Verify the sheet title reads "Log In", the prompt "Log in to site.example?" and the confirm button (testTag "LnurlAuthContinue") "Log In", then tap Cancel (testTag "LnurlAuthCancel")

Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:LNURL1DP68GURN8GHJ7UMFW3JJUETCV9KHQMR99ASH2ARG8A6XZEEAD3HKW6TWYE4NZ0T9XFSKVD3JX56XZWRYVC6RXVEJXC6XVCFJXDNRVDM9VGURZWPCXCEN2EP3X43K2WPCXDJNSENRXQERQWFC89JR2E3CXFSK2DNXXYCK2FNPVD6XJMMW84EX2EMFWD6X2USW52EHG" to.bitkit.dev` (action=register)
Verify the sheet title reads "Register", the prompt "Register at site.example?" and the confirm button "Register", then tap Cancel

Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:LNURL1DP68GURN8GHJ7UMFW3JJUETCV9KHQMR99ASH2ARG8A6XZEEAD3HKW6TWYE4NZ0T9XFSKVD3JX56XZWRYVC6RXVEJXC6XVCFJXDNRVDM9VGURZWPCXCEN2EP3X43K2WPCXDJNSENRXQERQWFC89JR2E3CXFSK2DNXXYCK2FNPVD6XJMMW84KXJMNTCD590A" to.bitkit.dev` (action=link)
Verify the sheet title reads "Link", the prompt "Link account to site.example?" and the confirm button "Link", then tap Cancel

Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:LNURL1DP68GURN8GHJ7UMFW3JJUETCV9KHQMR99ASH2ARG8A6XZEEAD3HKW6TWYE4NZ0T9XFSKVD3JX56XZWRYVC6RXVEJXC6XVCFJXDNRVDM9VGURZWPCXCEN2EP3X43K2WPCXDJNSENRXQERQWFC89JR2E3CXFSK2DNXXYCK2FNPVD6XJMMW84SH2ARGGNGZ9C" to.bitkit.dev` (action=auth)
Verify the sheet title reads "Authenticate", the prompt "Authenticate at site.example?" and the confirm button "Authenticate", then tap Cancel

Verify the sheet title reads "Authenticate" and the prompt "Authenticate at site.example?", then tap Cancel
